verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official CLI for driving or scripting Sill. Homebrew install/upgrade and shasum verification are host-platform tools, not Sill's own CLI. `swift run -c release SillHost` is a developer from-source way to run the streaming host (with a `--synthetic` test pattern), not an official command-line interface for user or agent workflows, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
